summary: Retest focused on the Change History / Revision removal request plus a full regression sweep. Backend suite: 41/41 passed. Confirmed via source inspection (VendorProfile.jsx, WorkOrderDetail.jsx, Bills.jsx) and 3 new browser checks that no 'Change History' section (data-testid vendor-history / bill-detail-history) or 'Revision' field exists on the Vendor Details page, the Work Order detail page, or the bill-detail dialog for BILL00042627 - for both vendor AE0001JV2627 and admin views. Vendor Details page still renders Company Name, Bank Details and Registration & Approval (Registration Date/Approval Date/Approved By/Checked By/Prepared By/Registration Expiry/Status, no Revision) correctly. Bill detail dialog still shows amounts, verification block, 5-step Payment Timeline, Line Items table and Download Invoice PDF. Re-ran 10 existing persisted browser checks covering work orders dedup/status/sync, vendor read-only view, documents, and login flows - all passed unchanged, confirming no regression. One minor observation (not a bug): the Bills.jsx bill-detail dialog header still shows 'Rev {revision}' text alongside the invoice/bill-no subtitle; the acceptance matrix only requires the absence of a Revision field on Vendor Details and Work Order Detail pages, so this is out of scope of the stated criteria and not flagged as a defect - noted for main agent awareness only.

action_items: Informational only (not a bug): Bills.jsx bill-detail dialog subtitle still renders 'Rev {revision}' text next to the invoice/bill-no line. The acceptance matrix only required Revision removal from the Vendor Details and Work Order Detail pages (and Change History removal from Bills), so this is outside the stated scope and left as-is; flag to main agent only if the Revision-removal intent was meant to be dialog-wide.
